messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER — smart-router-eu-west reports sustained 5xx spike for economy tier. ~2.3k errors/min. Affected customers: Acme, BrightLeaf, Lumen. Paging SRE now.

javier_sre: acknowledged, jumping on it. any quick signal which backend is failing?

nora_ops: observability shows backend v2 behind euw-rt-3 cluster has rising latency then 502s. traffic to economy lane up 4x last 12m.

javier_sre: got it. plan: 1) temp throttle economy tier to 10rps/user 2) steer regionally to eu-west-fallback pool 3) bump quota for dedicated tenants only if needed. applying 1 first.

nora_ops: +1. throttle command ready.

javier_sre: ```
# emergency throttle
smartctl routes update --region eu-west --tier economy --max-rps 10 --note "emergency 5xx mitigation"
```

deploy-bot: action accepted: routes update queued (change-id: 01F7EMER). Will apply to euw-rt-3 in ~15s.

javier_sre: applying now. watching errors.

sam_prod: heads-up — notifying Acme and BrightLeaf support with ETA for mitigation. I'll include status channel.

anne.dev: oncall handoff in 35m. If this persists I'll take first responder.

nora_ops: errors dropped to ~420/min after throttle. latency trending down. economy qps reduced by 70%. Looks promising.

javier_sre: nice. next step: enable regional steering to favor eu-west-fallback and disable economy lane overflow to edge nodes temporarily. small command:

javier_sre: ```
smartctl steer set --from-region eu-west --to-pool eu-west-fallback --tier economy --weight 0.8 --note "emergency steer"
smartctl routes update --region eu-west --tier economy --overflow disable
```

deploy-bot: steer change executed (change-id: 01F7STEER). overflow flag set for economy in eu-west.

sam_prod: customer notes: Acme reported degraded latency in chat feature since 10:12. I've told them we've throttled economy and steering is in progress.

nora_ops: monitoring: economy 5xx now ~90/min after steer. overall 5xx baseline restored to ~12/min.

javier_sre: rolling back throttle only when stable for 10m. keeping steer for 30m and then re-evaluate.

anne.dev: taking point for follow-ups. @sam_prod please paste the customer copy you sent so I can keep updates consistent.

sam_prod: copy pasted in #support-updates. short version: "We've applied an emergency routing and temporary rate limit to reduce errors. Expect improvement within minutes; we'll share updates." :thumbsup:

javier_sre: small post-mortem notes to capture: root appears to be v2 backend connection pool exhaustion under sudden economy-burst traffic. mitigation path: emergency throttle -> regional steer -> disable overflow. Need medium-term: autoscaling thresholds and per-backend circuit breaker.

nora_ops: logging ticket created: INF-4622 (scale & circuit-breaker). assigned to infra oncall.

deploy-bot: incident mitigation state: PARTIALLY_MITIGATED. change-ids: [01F7EMER,01F7STEER].

pagerduty-bot: PAGER NOTE — Severity lowered. Continue monitoring. If error rate rises above 300/min reopen page.

anne.dev: I'll stay on the thread for the next 40m, then hand to javier for overnight watch.

javier_sre: ack. if anything spikes I'll escalate to infra and contact Eng-RT.

sam_prod: I'll send customer follow-up in 10m with current metrics and next steps.

pagerduty-bot: RESOLUTION UPDATE — economy 5xx reduced to baseline. Incident moved to monitoring.

nora_ops: marking this thread closed-for-now. INF-4622 will track follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
